_comment: Model responses per case id, replayed by RecordedCopywriter in the offline eval. Recorded with `python -m evals creative --writer claude --record` (house-style prompt, 2026-11-21); gym-trio, gym-duo, coffee-vs-energy and big-group are kept as deliberately bad stand-ins (changed price, bland, invalid output, timeout) so the fallback path is measured too. Re-recording overwrites them: restore them afterwards. latency_ms values are the earlier stand-ins, not the live run's (live Haiku p95 was ~4.4 s on 2026-11-21, above the 2.5 s copy timeout).
